title: zygopetalum cochleare
intro: Zygopetalum cochleare, commonly known as the shell orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Brazil. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Zygopetalum cochleare include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, boost the immune system, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-edematous, anti-nociceptive, and anti-inflammatory effects, primarily due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
